name: Benyamin Bolhassani

description: Software engineer with 7 years of experience building web platforms and applications. I work across backend and frontend, with a focus on Laravel, CRM and reservation systems, health applications, and management dashboards.

projects.title: Eventoment
projects.description: Event booking platform for private hospitals, built with Laravel and Nuxt.js.
projects.longDescription: Eventoment is an event reservation platform for private hospitals. I worked on the Laravel backend and Nuxt.js frontend, added Google SSO authentication and PWA support, and improved media transfer with streaming uploads and downloads for the Android app.

projects.title: Safar 360
projects.description: Travel-booking platform with a multi-tenant reservation core for agencies.

projects.title: Catalyst / Azar
projects.description: Automotive catalyst pricing platform with customizable calculation formulas.
projects.longDescription: Catalyst calculates automotive catalyst prices with custom, dynamic formulas. Its management panel is built with Laravel, Filament, Livewire and Alpine.js.
features: Management panel built with Laravel, Filament, Livewire and Alpine.js

projects.title: D2Type
projects.description: Diabetes care app for health data, food analysis and daily goals.
projects.longDescription: D2Type is a diabetes care app built with Laravel. It connects with Health Connect on Android and HealthKit on Apple devices, analyzes health data and food portions, creates daily and weekly goals approved by a doctor, and reports errors through Sentry.

brain.title: A shared 'Rules' framework for AI-augmented teams
brain.body: Turn the documentation framework I built at Web Negah into something portable — a set of conventions that let any team brief their AI agents consistently across projects.

brain.title: Multi-agent code review pipeline
brain.body: Chain specialized agents — one for correctness, one for performance, one for consistency with project conventions — and have them hand off findings the way a human review team would.

brain.title: Series: 'From ~900 queries to ~30'
brain.body: Walk through the exact eager-loading and query-optimization process that took a real production flow on Eventoment from ~900 database queries down to ~30, on camera.

brain.title: Modular Laravel starter for new client projects
brain.body: Package the reusable pieces — auth, multi-tenancy, admin scaffolding — that speed up the start of nearly every new project at Web Negah into a public starter kit.

brain.title: Formula-engine playground
brain.body: A small sandbox that mirrors the custom-formula engines I've built for Steel Rizan and Azar PMR — so non-developers can prototype pricing logic without touching code.

brain.title: Live build: a multi-agent system from scratch
brain.body: Start from an empty repo and build a working multi-agent AI system end to end — orchestration, tool use, and the documentation that keeps it maintainable.
